title: Your first request: select, save and verify
goal: Select a particular customer and service, fill a request, save it and reopen it for verification.

prerequisites.text: Continue in your NexusReferenceService after the previous lesson, with Учебный Восток — сервис and Учебный Запад. If absent, create them using the previous lesson. We prepare the service item here; no BSL is needed.

sections.title: A customer and a visit are different records
paragraphs: A customer can visit many times. Do not rewrite their customer card as if the person became “a 30-minute diagnosis”. A request document represents one visit with a chosen customer, service and work details. The catalog records who the customer is; the document records an occurrence.

Our goal is to save a request and read it from the base again, rather than just type into a form. That lets us explain what persisted. Posting is disabled in this training service: Save records the document, but does not imply a payment, register movements or completed service.

sections.title: Prepare a clear service item first
paragraphs: In Enterprise open Services → Create. For the example use Учебная диагностика: enter that name and ТарифЗаЧас = 600, then Save and close and reopen the row. The rate is training data, not a real price or an automatic payment. If you already made this item in this route, find it instead of duplicating it.

The task uses another service: Учебная настройка at rate 900. Create it the same way and verify it by reopening. Selecting a service later therefore requires no guess about where it came from. There is no need to calculate a charge or open reports yet.

sections.title: Example of one request
paragraphs: Open Requests (the Заявка услуги document command) → Create. Use the Customer field’s selection button to choose a saved card from its list. The illustration uses Учебный Север; you need not create that example customer merely to read it. Your task selects your own East record. The field selects a particular record, not arbitrary label text.

Similarly select Учебная диагностика. Enter ДлительностьМинут = 30, choose Статус = Новая, and add comment Учебный пример. Keep the suggested date for this exercise. A number is assigned when saving; do not copy a screenshot’s number. Choose Save and close, find your own number in the list and reopen the request.

code.source:
Клиент: Учебный Север
Услуга: Учебная диагностика
ДлительностьМинут: 30
Статус: Новая
Комментарий: Учебный пример
code.output: After saving and reopening, the selected records, 30 minutes, Новая status and comment are visible.

sections.title: Verify fields rather than impressions
paragraphs: Compare every field of the reopened document with the task: customer, service, duration, status and comment. If another request has a similar customer name, return to the list and use your own number. Name search is convenient, but one customer may have several documents.

For a safe error exercise, open a new unsaved request, choose service and status but leave the customer empty. Saving should require a customer and service; the incomplete form does not become a saved request. Close it without saving and verify that your correct request remains accessible. Do not perform the experiment in a working base or by deleting records.

sections.title: A new visit to your service
paragraphs: Create a new request for Учебный Восток — сервис and Учебная настройка, 20 minutes, Новая status, comment Мой первый заказ. Save it, note its number and reopen it. The customer, service, duration and comment differ from the example, while all required actions have already been introduced.

Record the fields actually observed after reopening and the rejection from the incomplete new form. If something differs, identify the field and action rather than writing only “does not work”. This completes the starting chain: find the service → save a customer → record a visit. Understanding is assessed through actions and explanations, not a saved Nexus note.

practice.title: On your own: East’s first request
practice.task: Prepare Учебная настройка at rate 900. Create a new request: customer Учебный Восток — сервис; service Учебная настройка; duration 20; status Новая; comment Мой первый заказ. Save, close, find it by its number and compare every field. Separately verify rejection of a new form without a customer.
practice.environment: Official installed 1C in a separate training infobase. Nexus shows the lesson and keeps an optional draft; it does not run this program.
practice.externalRoute: Follow the steps labelled by application. The self-report field records your external observation; it is not Nexus verification.

passport.goal: Save a particular visit and verify its persisted fields.
passport.start: Your service, East saved in the previous lesson; create the service here.
passport.knowledge: Create, select, fields, save, search and reopen.
passport.change: Fields of a new training request; preserve earlier documents.
passport.inputs: Учебный Восток — сервис; Учебная настройка; 20; Новая; Мой первый заказ
passport.result: A reopened document with all specified fields and its own number.
passport.checks: Actual reopening, an incomplete new-form control and a self-report with limitations.
passport.errors: Text typed instead of selecting a record; wrong number opened; unsaved form.
passport.recovery: Close the incorrect unsaved form without saving. Reopen the correct document; preserve earlier work.

steps.action: Create and reopen Учебная настройка, ТарифЗаЧас=900.
steps.why: So the action has an observable, reproducible result.
steps.expected: The service is available for selection.

steps.action: Select your East record and the service, enter 20 minutes, Новая and the comment, then save.
steps.why: So the action has an observable, reproducible result.
steps.expected: Your request has its own number.

steps.action: Reopen by your number and compare fields; separately try a new form without a customer and close it unsaved.
steps.why: So the action has an observable, reproducible result.
steps.expected: The correct record remains available; rejection is not reported as success.

cases.label: Valid request
cases.input: East; setup; 20; Новая; Мой первый заказ.
cases.output: The same values are read after reopening.

cases.label: Incomplete new form
cases.input: Customer omitted, other mandatory fields supplied.
cases.output: Save is rejected; the earlier correct request remains.

criteria: Customer and service were selected from their lists.
The document was reopened by its actual number.
Incomplete-form rejection is separate; saving is not described as payment or posting.
practice.hint: Check each field in the reopened request, rather than old text in a form.

referenceSolution.source: Example result: Учебная настройка was saved with rate 900. The new request reopened by its own number contains Учебный Восток — сервис, Учебная настройка, 20 minutes, Новая, Мой первый заказ. It is a separate visit; the customer card did not become a request. Saving a new form without a customer was rejected while the correct document remained available. Posting is disabled here; saving is not payment. State unperformed actions honestly.
paragraphs: A reference for reasoning and expected observation. It neither fills your record nor certifies completion.

selfcheck.prompt: What does a request’s Customer field select?
selfcheck.feedback: The selection is tied to a customer card, not just its name text.

selfcheck.prompt: Does Save in our training service mean the service was paid for?
selfcheck.feedback: Posting is disabled; saving proves neither payment nor completed work.

selfcheck.prompt: How do you verify that the intended request was saved?
options: Reopen by its number and compare the fields
selfcheck.feedback: Verify the state read back from the infobase.

selfcheck.prompt: Where do you prepare a missing service item?
options: Rename the customer to the service
selfcheck.feedback: A service is a separate catalog record.

selfcheck.prompt: A new form without a customer was rejected. What is the result?
options: Rejection and retention of the earlier valid document
selfcheck.feedback: An expected rejection is a separate observation, not successful saving.

selfcheck.prompt: Explain a customer card, request, saving and posting. Name the fields of the document you actually reopened.
selfcheck.feedback: Compare your explanation with the walkthrough; it is not graded automatically.
